node: AI-server high-end passives and board-level power delivery
summary: Layer 1B expands the AI-server passives and board-level power-delivery node into a two-lane universe. The strongest reference evidence points to Murata as a high-end MLCC leader, while the underfollowed discovery lane is more investable through US-listed power-delivery and component suppliers such as Vicor, Bel Fuse, and Vishay. The key chokepoint to verify is whether AI-server demand is creating tightness in high-capacitance low-ESR/low-ESL MLCCs, polymer/tantalum capacitors, power inductors, 48V/vertical power-delivery modules, and data-center power/connectivity components rather than broad commodity passives.
